{{Quote|I was a pilot in the Ividal Sector Forces&ndash;Foxfire Squadron&ndash;when the Republic came calling. They had ground troops, but they needed their fighter squadrons over at Uvadala, so they came our way looking for dirt flyers.|Jorn Kulish|<ref name="Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-10-the-rise-of-the-empire|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 10: The Rise of the Empire}}</ref>}}
The '''Ividal Sector Forces''' was a [[Planetary Security Forces|defense force]] that operated in the [[Ividal sector/Legends|Ividal sector]] during the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], following the [[Attack on Ongary IX|capture]] of [[Ongary IX]] by the forces of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the Ividal [[Sector/Legends|Sector]] Forces supplied a number of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] to support the Republic counterattack, the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military's]] squadrons being committed to a military operation at [[Uvadala]]. During the battle, the Ividal unit [[Foxfire Squadron]] was deployed to fire [[burrowing plasma charge]]s to flush out the Separatist forces.
